analysis: The trial crashed after consuming 864.88 GPU-seconds and returned no validation score. The supplied traceback only reports that train.py exited with status 1; it does not reveal the underlying exception or establish whether training or verification failed. The added exception logging, nonfinite-loss detection, and within-epoch deadline check cannot be confirmed effective from this output. No accuracy improvement was demonstrated.
code_summary: One independently trained model per category: 96-dimensional item embeddings, a GRU contextual encoder, candidate-conditioned attention over causal history, and an MLP scorer with jointly trained item biases. Training uses 32 sampled negatives, recency-weighted sampled-softmax and auxiliary logistic losses, AdamW, gradient clipping, and checkpointed scoring chunks. Validation selects one checkpoint per category by HR@10, breaking ties with NDCG@10. The predictor writer exports the shared architecture and dataset routing, loading exactly one checkpoint for each category; no ensemble is used.
